מזל.definition: constellation, stars; planet: any of the seven major celestial bodies that move relative to the stars in the night sky; that is, the Sun, Venus, Mercury, the Moon, Saturn, Jupiter, or Mars; astrological sign (especially, any of the twelve cardinal ones in the best-known zodiac schemas); fortune, fate, destiny: that which happens to a given person at a given time, due supposedly to the positions of the planets in the Zodiac at that time and at the time of that person's birth; luck, chance, fortune: that which happens due to chance rather than to planning; luck, good luck, good fortune
